name: Dorukus
backstory: Child of Nakus and Prince Doran; raised in Salthos Cruzados on holds court at the square each morning, hears..., and carries some knowledge of Salthos Mediator Line.

Heard that Darika and Darnakus now have a child, Darinak.

criterion.standard: counts it worthwhile only by paying real attention to Gorff Ledger Crossing War
criterion.wasted_life: letting Gorff Ledger Crossing War slip past unexamined, the way it's easiest to
criterion.trusts: a story that's been carried and retold and still holds together
criterion.distrusts: a record that insists on a precision no one who was actually there ever needed

routines.routine_actions: sits in judgment at the square when it's his turn, leans on the clerks' records more than his own memory, and walks the crossing at dusk out of old habit

arc.premise: Dorukus keeps hearing two different versions of the old Crossing War from the petitioners who come before him, and has quietly started weighing which telling actually holds up before he hands a ruling down.
